mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies with a temperature of 59 degrees at the Verona Area High School, and the moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The city has been updating engineering records with AECOM, and residents are encouraged to attend upcoming public meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study happening in November to provide feedback on new design concepts.

There is plenty to do, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia, all happening today. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run, the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event, and live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly police report, on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I offence after finding him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's which opens today at 10:00 AM to serve up today's flavor, OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
